summary: Updated isBlockedByDependencies and hasDependencyBlocked in workflow-helpers.ts to use the canonical metadata-based check per §21.54: status === 'BLOCKED' && (blocked_by == null || blocked_by.type === 'dependency'). Removed second parameter from both functions and updated all 12 call sites in workflow-handoff.ts, 3 in workflow-next-action.ts, and 1 in workflow-batch-actions.ts. comments.note: workflow-helpers.ts: isBlockedByDependencies and hasDependencyBlocked now have identical bodies. They are retained as separate exports for call-site clarity per the spec's design intent, but the duplication could be resolved by having one delegate to the other (e.g. hasDependencyBlocked = isBlockedByDependencies).
